\subsection{Findings on the libraries and on Layer 0}\label{sec:gen-lib-findings}

No finding of this section is a defect of a leanerVM theorem: nothing in the libraries' objects or
in Layer 0 lets an unsound verifier be \enquote{proved}. The fields are leanVM's bit for bit, the
samplers are uniform by proof, the oracle answers the specification's evaluation, the counting
bounds are correct and non-vacuous, and the trusted base is the kernel plus the three standard
axioms, enforced transitively. The findings concern what ArkLib's notions do and do not guarantee,
what the blueprint plans on, and the blueprint's text.

\begin{finding}{critical}{f:lib-existential-rbr}{The existential form of round-by-round knowledge soundness has no knowledge content}
\textsf{Critical as a warning about the definition; not a defect of a leanerVM theorem.}
\fhead{Evidence} \lean{Extractor.RoundByRound} (\file{Security/}\allowbreak\file{RoundByRound.lean:77-86} at
\code{dca90385}) is a structure of unconstrained functions; the probe \code{Extractors} builds
\lean{chooser R}, which selects a witness by \lean{Classical.choice}, and proves
\lean{chooser_}\allowbreak\lean{sound : rbrKnowledgeSoundnessWorstCaseWith … (chooser R) … (fun _}\allowbreak\lean{ => 0)} for the
verifier that decides the language of any relation \lean{R}. ArkLib's own
\lean{toRoundByRoundOfRel} (\file{:118-123}) does the same (\cref{sec:gen-lib-ark-extractors}).
\fhead{Classification} A deviation forced by an upstream library; ArkLib has no notion of running
time.
\fhead{Consequence for leanerVM} \lean{piop_}\allowbreak\lean{rbrKnowledgeSoundness_}\allowbreak\lean{exists} and any theorem stated
with \lean{rbrKnowledgeSoundness} or \lean{rbrKnowledgeSoundnessWorstCase} (the blueprint's
Layer 9 \lean{FlockInterface.}\allowbreak\lean{rbrKnowledgeSoundness : … rbrKnowledgeSoundnessWorstCase …},
\file{protocol-blueprint.md:1084}, and its Layer 10 sketch, \file{:1127-1129}) are soundness
statements, not knowledge statements. The named form the spine uses is adequate only together
with a reading of the extractor.
\fhead{Proposed change} In the blueprint's row for \lean{rbrKnowledgeSoundness} (\file{:239}) and
in the wrong-readings item 24 (\file{:1333}), add: \enquote{ArkLib's extractor type accepts a
classical choice (ArkLib's \lean{toRoundByRoundOfRel} is one); a theorem in the existential forms
\lean{rbrKnowledgeSoundness} or \lean{rbrKnowledgeSoundnessWorstCase} therefore proves soundness
only. Every interface and theorem of this roadmap is stated in the \lean{With} form with a compiled
extractor, and the compiled status is checked by a \lean{def} without \lean{noncomputable} at each
phase's \lean{Security}.} Change \lean{FlockInterface.}\allowbreak\lean{rbrKnowledgeSoundness} (\file{:1084}) to the
\lean{With} form with named extractor and state function.
\end{finding}

\begin{finding}{major}{f:lib-completeness-error}{The spine's completeness cannot carry an error, and Flock may need one}
\fhead{Evidence} \lean{Component.}\allowbreak\lean{Complete.}\allowbreak\lean{complete} is \lean{perfectCompleteness}
(\file{LeanerVM/}\allowbreak\file{Protocol/}\allowbreak\file{ToArkLib/}\allowbreak\file{Component.lean:84-85}); the blueprint's \lean{FlockInterface}
demands \lean{perfectCompleteness} (\file{protocol-blueprint.md:1083}) and item 20 of the wrong
readings (\file{:1323-1325}) charges the Flock inverse's failure at $r_{\mathrm{eq}} = 1$ to
\lean{flockError}, a soundness error. The pinned Rust prover takes the inverse
(\file{crates/}\allowbreak\file{flock/}\allowbreak\file{src/}\allowbreak\file{zerocheck.rs:117}), which is $0$ at $r_{\mathrm{eq}} = 1$
(\file{crates/}\allowbreak\file{primitives/}\allowbreak\file{src/}\allowbreak\file{field/}\allowbreak\file{gf2_64x3.rs:144-153}). ArkLib at both pins composes
completeness with additive errors (\lean{Reduction.}\allowbreak\lean{append_}\allowbreak\lean{completeness_}\allowbreak\lean{of_guarded_}\allowbreak\lean{verifiers},
\file{GuardedCompleteness.lean:161-173}, and the oracle and $n$-ary forms), proved
(\cref{sec:gen-lib-ark-completeness}).
\fhead{Classification} An error of the blueprint, if the honest Flock prover fails at
$r_{\mathrm{eq}} = 1$, which the Flock review must confirm; otherwise a note.
% Register note (dossiers/register.md, staging lib-arklib): DISAGREEMENT with gt-flock-ring FR4/FR12
% (the specification's Flock is perfectly complete; the defect is the Rust prover's, so the Lean
% prover should send true coefficients and needs no error). For the orchestrator to reconcile.
\fhead{Proposed change} Add a field \lean{err : ℝ≥0} to \lean{Component.Complete} (or to
\lean{Component.Def}) with \lean{complete : ∀ init impl, D.}\allowbreak\lean{red.}\allowbreak\lean{completeness init impl relIn relOut err},
compose by \lean{OracleReduction.}\allowbreak\lean{append_}\allowbreak\lean{completeness_}\allowbreak\lean{of_guarded_}\allowbreak\lean{verifiers} ($\mathit{err}_1 +
\mathit{err}_2$), state \lean{piop_completeness} with the sum and \lean{piop_perfectCompleteness}
as its corollary when every phase's error is $0$; give \lean{FlockInterface} a completeness error;
and rewrite item 20:
\begin{change}{item 20 of the wrong readings (\file{protocol-blueprint.md:1323-1325})}
\asis \enquote{Perfect completeness needs no exceptional-challenge clause in Layers 4--8 and 10: no
inverse of a challenge is taken. Flock's $(1 + r_{\mathrm{eq}})^{-1}$ at $r_{\mathrm{eq}} = 1$ is
\#3's, inside \lean{flockError}. Witness: \lean{piop_perfectCompleteness} has no side condition on
challenges.}
\asproposed \enquote{No phase of Layers 4--8 and 10 takes an inverse of a challenge; the Flock
phase's completeness error is its own field and is summed.}
\reason A completeness failure cannot be charged to \lean{flockError}, which is a soundness error;
if the Flock phase has a completeness error, \lean{FlockInterface}'s \lean{perfectCompleteness}
field is unsatisfiable and \lean{piop_perfectCompleteness} is vacuous for the real protocol.
\end{change}
\end{finding}

\begin{finding}{major}{f:lib-legacy-framework}{The blueprint plans on a framework ArkLib calls legacy, and on a pull request that may not merge}
\fhead{Evidence} ArkLib's \file{AGENTS.md} at both pins calls \file{ArkLib/}\allowbreak\file{OracleReduction/}
\enquote{legacy}; issue \#676's refreshed scope directs composition work to the typed framework;
\file{docs/}\allowbreak\file{design/}\allowbreak\file{05-roadmap.md} at \code{7653a901}; the typed framework has no knowledge
soundness, no round-by-round notion and no extractor; pull request \#615 is open and conflicting;
no relevant admission was lifted between the pins (\cref{sec:gen-lib-ark-port,sec:gen-lib-ark-new}).
The blueprint's ledger says of the knowledge-soundness composition (ledger row A2) \enquote{the
port is deleted \dots\ when the pin moves past \#615} (\file{:260}, \file{:1143}, \file{:1429})
and of the round-by-round to plain implications (A3) \enquote{the plain corollary is stated once
the implication lands upstream} (\file{:261}).
\fhead{Classification} An error of the blueprint's plan.
\fhead{Proposed change}
\begin{change}{the ledger's actions on the knowledge-soundness composition (A2) and on round-by-round to plain (A3) (\file{protocol-blueprint.md:260-261})}
\asis Composition (A2): \enquote{the port is deleted \dots\ when the pin moves past \#615}. Round-by-round to plain (A3): \enquote{the
plain corollary is stated once the implication lands upstream}.
\asproposed Composition (A2): \enquote{kept until ArkLib, on whatever framework, proves a guarded-first append
for the worst-case named form; if the legacy framework is not repaired, the port stays as a
\lean{ToArkLib} candidate}. Round-by-round to plain (A3): \enquote{the plain corollary is stated from the transcript-level
reading (the probe \code{PlainReading} proves it in 40 lines) and a union bound proved locally,
since upstream has no plan to prove \lean{rbrKnowledgeSoundness_}\allowbreak\lean{implies_}\allowbreak\lean{knowledgeSoundness}}. Add
a ledger row: \enquote{typed Interaction framework: no knowledge soundness at \code{7653a901};
migration of the spine is not possible until it has one}.
\reason Upstream's stated direction is migration, not repair of the legacy admissions.
\end{change}
\end{finding}

\begin{finding}{major}{f:lib-fs-bcs}{Fiat--Shamir and BCS: ArkLib has no statement to serve as the witness obligation}
\fhead{Evidence} The blueprint's ledger row on Fiat--Shamir and BCS security (A5, \file{:263}) plans \enquote{Named interfaces
\lean{FiatShamirSecurity} and \lean{BcsSecurity} with the upstream theorem as witness obligation}.
At both pins: \lean{fiatShamir_completeness} (\file{FiatShamir/}\allowbreak\file{Basic.lean:163-173}) is admitted
\textbf{and} initialises the challenge oracle to the constant function
\lean{fun ⟨i, _⟩ => default}, so it is not a random-oracle statement and is false in general for a
protocol with a non-zero completeness error whose honest prover fails at the default challenge
(the dossier's inference, not machine-checked); Fiat--Shamir soundness is a \code{TODO}
(\file{:175}); the round-by-round to state-restoration statements are commented out
(\file{Implications.lean:230-254}); \lean{BCSTransform} is commented out (\file{BCS/Basic.lean});
\lean{Commitment.extractability} is \lean{False} under quantifiers
(\file{Commitments/}\allowbreak\file{Functional/}\allowbreak\file{Basic.lean:250-255}). Also, \lean{Verifier.fiatShamir}
(\file{FiatShamir/}\allowbreak\file{Basic.lean:130-136}) applies to a plain \lean{Verifier} whose messages are whole;
on \lean{toVerifier} of the IOPP it would hash entire oracle messages, so the blueprint's
\lean{verify_iff_compiled} sketch, \enquote{\lean{Verifier.}\allowbreak\lean{fiatShamir (leanVmIopp …).}\allowbreak\lean{verifier}
accepts \dots\ under the BLAKE2s challenge oracle} (\file{:1218-1221}), names an ArkLib definition
that does not describe leanVM's compiled verifier (Merkle roots in the transcript, openings in the
proof).
\fhead{Classification} An error of the blueprint.
\fhead{Proposed change}
\begin{change}{the ledger row on Fiat--Shamir and BCS security (A5, \file{protocol-blueprint.md:263}) and the \lean{verify_iff_compiled} sketch (\file{:1218-1221})}
\asis \enquote{Named interfaces \lean{FiatShamirSecurity} and \lean{BcsSecurity} with the upstream
theorem as witness obligation.}
\asproposed State that no ArkLib theorem, at either pin, states Fiat--Shamir or BCS knowledge
soundness, that \lean{fiatShamir_completeness} as stated is not the random-oracle model, and that
\lean{FiatShamirSecurity} and \lean{BcsSecurity} are assumed interfaces whose witness obligation is
the literature (Block et al., ePrint 2023/1071, Theorem 3.15, \cref{sec:gen-lib-ark-implications})
until ArkLib states them. Drop \lean{Verifier.fiatShamir} from \lean{verify_iff_compiled}, or apply
it to a verifier of the compiled (Merkle-root) protocol.
\reason There is no upstream theorem to serve as the witness obligation, and the named definition
does not describe the compiled verifier.
\end{change}
\end{finding}

\begin{finding}{minor}{f:lib-err-noncomputable}{The error bundled in \texorpdfstring{\lean{Component.Def}}{Component.Def} makes every phase and the composed protocol noncomputable}
\textsf{Minor (auditability).}
\fhead{Evidence} \lean{publicInputPhase} is \lean{noncomputable} \enquote{because of the error
alone} (\file{PublicInput.lean:374-381}); the probe \code{ExtractorsExpectedFailure} shows that the
verifier and the extractor reached through the phase's definition are rejected by the compiler.
\lean{leanVmVerifier P := P.}\allowbreak\lean{toDef.}\allowbreak\lean{red.}\allowbreak\lean{verifier} and \lean{piopExtractor P S} take the bundle
\lean{P} as an argument, so on the real protocol neither is compiled; the blueprint promises
\enquote{the honest prover is computable} (\file{protocol-blueprint.md:1145}) and \enquote{the
extractor computes} (\file{:1333}) and plans code-generation probes
(\cref{sec:gen-lib-ark-extractors}).
\fhead{Proposed change} Move \lean{err} out of \lean{Component.Def} into the \lean{Security}
structure (it is a property of the soundness proof, not of the reduction), or keep the reduction in
a separate computable structure that \lean{Def} extends; then \lean{leanVmPiop},
\lean{leanVmVerifier} and \lean{piopExtractor} compile.
\end{finding}

\begin{finding}{minor}{f:lib-ladder-conflates}{The relation ladder conflates the field sum with Clean's balance relation}
\fhead{Evidence} \file{protocol-blueprint.md:359} at \code{b435631} (\file{:363} at
\code{144c5aa}, same text). The probe \code{CleanBalance} (\cref{sec:gen-lib-clean-vacuous}):
\lean{pushedTwice_balance} (the field sum of \lean{[push 7, push 7]} is $0$) but
\lean{pushedTwice_not_balanced} (Clean's \lean{BalancedInteractions} rejects it, through the side
condition), and \lean{length_le_one_of_balanced}, \lean{honest_pair_not_balanced},
\lean{statement_}\allowbreak\lean{forces_}\allowbreak\lean{at_most_}\allowbreak\lean{one_}\allowbreak\lean{interaction}.
\fhead{Classification} An error of the blueprint (imprecise wording; the conclusion
\enquote{unusable here} is right).
\fhead{Proposed change}
\begin{change}{the relation-ladder row on Clean's balance (\file{protocol-blueprint.md:359})}
\asis \enquote{Over $\K$ the side condition fails for every real ensemble and a tuple pushed twice
and never pulled balances (\#16).}
\asproposed \enquote{Over $\K$ (\lean{ringChar K = 2}) the field sum alone accepts a tuple pushed
twice and never pulled ($1 + 1 = 0$), and the side condition \lean{length < ringChar K} that is
meant to exclude it admits at most one interaction per channel, so \lean{Ensemble.Statement} holds
of no ensemble with a real bus: Clean's soundness is vacuous and its completeness false over $\K$
(\#16).}
\reason The reader should see that Clean's relation is unsatisfiable, not unsound.
\end{change}
\end{finding}

\begin{finding}{minor}{f:lib-k-sampler-unused}{\texorpdfstring{\lean{SampleableType K}}{SampleableType K} is unused audit surface, and the blueprint disagrees with itself about it}
\fhead{Evidence} No consumer outside \file{Protocol/}\allowbreak\file{Field.lean}; leanVM samples only $\E$
(\file{crates/}\allowbreak\file{fiat_shamir/}\allowbreak\file{src/}\allowbreak\file{lib.rs:95-99}); at the old pins it is definitionally the library's
\lean{FinEnum.SampleableType K} (probe \code{SamplerDiamond2}; \cref{sec:gen-l0-samplers}). The
blueprint's Layer 0 sketch declares it (\file{protocol-blueprint.md:634}) while its dependency
table says \enquote{Layer 0 supplies the \lean{E} instance} (\file{:251}) and its interface list
names only \lean{instSampleableTypeE} (\file{:1400}).
\fhead{Classification} Avoidable audit surface (not a divergence from leanVM).
\fhead{Proposed change} Keep the instance only as the building block of the $\E$ sampler (VCVio's
\lean{Vector} instance needs \lean{SampleableType K}; at the new pins no library instance exists)
and say so.
\begin{change}{the Layer 0 sketch (\file{protocol-blueprint.md:634}) and the dependency row (\file{:251})}
\asis \code{instance : SampleableType K          -- a uniform Fin (2^64) read as a bit pattern}
\asproposed \code{instance : SampleableType K          -- a uniform Fin (2^64) read as a bit pattern; only the building block of the E sampler: every leanVM challenge is in E (fiat_shamir/src/lib.rs:95)}.
At \file{:251}: \enquote{Challenge sampling; Layer 0 supplies the \lean{E} instance (built from a
\lean{K} instance)}. The same comment on the instance's docstring in
\file{Protocol/}\allowbreak\file{Field.lean:80}.
\reason The sketch, the dependency row and the interface list should say the same thing.
\end{change}
\end{finding}

\begin{finding}{minor}{f:lib-evaloracle-answer-n}{\texorpdfstring{\lean{evalOracle_answer}}{evalOracle\_answer} takes \texorpdfstring{\lean{n}}{n} explicitly}

\begin{finding}{minor}{f:lib-scalar-interfaces}{The scalar oracle interfaces are trusted surface the blueprint does not list}
\fhead{Evidence} \lean{instOracleInterfaceE} and \lean{instOracleInterfaceListE}
(\file{Protocol/}\allowbreak\file{Field.lean:115}, \file{:118}) decide what a verifier may learn of a scalar or list

(\file{protocol-blueprint.md:633-650}) nor the interface list (\file{:1400}).
\fhead{Classification} An omission of the blueprint.
\fhead{Proposed change} Add to the Layer 0 sketch after \lean{evalOracle_answer}:
\code{instance : OracleInterface E := OracleInterface.instDefault        -- a scalar message is read whole}
and
\code{instance : OracleInterface (List E) := OracleInterface.instDefault  -- likewise a coefficient list},

test \texttt{\#synth}s will turn ambiguous).} Add both names and \lean{instSampleableTypeK} to

\begin{finding}{note}{f:lib-side-conditions-derivable}{\texorpdfstring{\lean{Component.Complete}}{Component.Complete}'s two side conditions are derivable}
Over \lean{[]ₒ}, \lean{Verifier.}\allowbreak\lean{GuardedForm.}\allowbreak\lean{ofEmpty} and \lean{Prover.}\allowbreak\lean{instOutputIsPureEmpty}
(\file{Composition/}\allowbreak\file{Sequential/}\allowbreak\file{NoAmbient.lean:39-55}, both pins) give \lean{guarded} and
\lean{outputPure} for every component; leanerVM proves them by hand (\lean{PublicInput.guarded},
\lean{sendVerifierPure}). Keeping the hand-written guarded forms is defensible (the check is
readable), but the fields could be defaults, shrinking what a phase author must supply.
\end{finding}

\begin{finding}{note}{f:lib-reimplemented}{Locally re-implemented objects that ArkLib has}
\lean{Component.passThrough} (\file{ToArkLib/}\allowbreak\file{PassThrough.lean}) is ArkLib's
\lean{ReduceClaim.}\allowbreak\lean{oracleReduction} with the identity oracle map (\file{ReduceClaim.lean:282-323},
proved completeness and existential round-by-round knowledge soundness, \file{:441});
\lean{Component.sendOracle} (\file{ToArkLib/}\allowbreak\file{SendOracle.lean}) is
\lean{SendSingleWitness.}\allowbreak\lean{oracleReduction} (\file{SendWitness.lean:395-443}, whose completeness is
admitted at both pins and whose knowledge soundness is only in the coordinate-wise
special-soundness form). The local versions are justified by the \lean{With} form with a guarded
form as data; the docstring of \file{SendOracle.lean:6} says so for \lean{SendSingleWitness}, the
one of \file{PassThrough.lean} does not name \lean{ReduceClaim}. \file{ToVCVio/}\allowbreak\file{UniformSample.lean}'s
bound for a subsingleton bad set has no ArkLib counterpart in VCVio's vocabulary (ArkLib's
\lean{prob_eval_zero_le_div} is on \lean{PMF}).
\end{finding}

\begin{finding}{note}{f:lib-eager-fintype}{The eager \texorpdfstring{\lean{Fintype BF64}}{Fintype BF64} blocked every executable at the old pins}
\textsf{Note; retired.}
\fhead{Evidence} \cref{sec:gen-lib-comppoly-fields}; \file{docs/}\allowbreak\file{roadmap/}\allowbreak\file{leanisa-status.md:753-769}
at \code{b435631}; CompPoly \#331 (\code{290c351}), in the new pin.
\fhead{Classification} A deviation forced by an upstream library (no executable verifier, no
differential tests, a library-only test driver); its retirement condition, \enquote{CompPoly stops
threading \lean{[Fintype F]} through \lean{Ext} and \lean{Fintype BF64} is not evaluated at
startup}, is \textbf{met at \code{144c5aa}} (\cref{sec:gen-lib-comppoly-new}). Whether
\code{lake test} can again be an executable is for the owner to check.
\end{finding}

\begin{finding}{note}{f:lib-simp-misreads-k}{\texorpdfstring{\lean{simp}}{simp} misreads \texorpdfstring{$\K$}{K} arithmetic (old pins)}
\textsf{Note; retired.}
\fhead{Evidence} The probe \code{NumeralHazard} (\cref{ch:probes}):
\lean{example : (1 : K) + 1 = 0 := by simp} leaves \lean{⊢ False} and the kernel rejects the term
(\texttt{application type mismatch … (2\#64 = 0\#64) = False}); \lean{theorem bad : ¬ ((1 : K) + 1 = 0) := by simp}
and \lean{theorem bad_}\allowbreak\lean{mul : (2 : K) * 0x8000000000000000 = 0 := by simp} are \emph{elaborated} by
\lean{simp} (core's \lean{BitVec} simplification procedures read $\K$'s \lean{+}, which is XOR, as
addition modulo $2^{64}$) and \textbf{rejected by the kernel} (\code{(kernel) declaration type mismatch}),
exit 1. So a false statement about $\K$ was not proved: the kernel is the safety net, and the axiom
audit is a second one (after the kernel error Lean adds \lean{bad} as an axiom for error recovery,
\code{'bad' depends on axioms: [bad, propext, Quot.sound]}, which \file{audit-axioms.lean} would
reject). Recorded in the leanISA status at \code{b435631}, as its finding on the eager instance (E6). Companion: CompPoly's instances
apply to every \lean{BitVec 64} (probe \code{FieldFidelity}: \texttt{(3 : BitVec 64) + 5 = 6\#64}); no
leanerVM misuse (\cref{sec:gen-lib-comppoly-fields}).
\fhead{Classification} Forced by an upstream library (\lean{abbrev BF64 := BitVec 64});
\textbf{retired} at the new pin by CompPoly \#329 (\lean{BF64} a structure). In its place, numerals
in $\K$ now mean their characteristic-two value (\cref{f:lib-numerals-changed}).
\end{finding}

\begin{finding}{note}{f:lib-numerals-changed}{Numerals in \texorpdfstring{$\K$}{K} changed meaning at the new pins}
\textsf{Note, for every later probe and fixture.}
\fhead{Evidence} $(2 : \K)$ is $x$ at CompPoly \code{3468b38c} and $0$ at \code{572f9973}; words are
\lean{K.ofBits n} at \code{144c5aa}. A literal written for the old pin compiles at the new one with
another value (\cref{sec:gen-lib-comppoly-new}). Pull request \#61 converted leanerVM's fixtures;
one comment is left behind: \file{tests/}\allowbreak\file{LeanerVMTests/}\allowbreak\file{Protocol/}\allowbreak\file{Field.lean:25-26} and \file{:37-38}
at \code{144c5aa} still say \enquote{The column \lean{[1, 2, 3, 4]}} and \enquote{\lean{1 + y·(1 + 2) = 1 + 3y}
\dots\ with \lean{-1 = 1} and \lean{2 = x}} while \lean{2 : K} is now $0$.
\fhead{Classification} An upstream change adopted; a documentation hazard.
\fhead{Proposed change}
\begin{change}{the comments of \file{tests/}\allowbreak\file{LeanerVMTests/}\allowbreak\file{Protocol/}\allowbreak\file{Field.lean:25-26, 37-38} (at \code{144c5aa})}
\asis \enquote{The column \lean{[1, 2, 3, 4]}}; \enquote{\lean{1 + y·(1 + 2) = 1 + 3y} \dots\ with
\lean{-1 = 1} and \lean{2 = x}}.
\asproposed \enquote{The column \lean{[1, x, x + 1, x²]} (words \lean{1, 2, 3, 4} as
\lean{K.ofBits}) \dots}; \enquote{at \lean{(y, 0)} the value is \lean{1 + y·(1 + x)}}.
\reason \lean{2 : K} is $0$ at the new pin. Any future probe of this review run at the new pins
must write words as \lean{K.ofBits} (the probe \code{FieldFidelity} would otherwise fail
spuriously).
\end{change}
\end{finding}

\begin{finding}{note}{f:lib-mle-bridge-unimportable}{ArkLib's bridge \texorpdfstring{\lean{eval_eq_MvPolynomial_MLE}}{eval\_eq\_MvPolynomial\_MLE} is likely unimportable at the new pins}
\textsf{Note; unverified.}
\fhead{Evidence} A duplicate \lean{CompPoly.}\allowbreak\lean{CMlPolynomialEval.}\allowbreak\lean{eval_}\allowbreak\lean{zero} in CompPoly \code{572f9973}
(\file{Multilinear/}\allowbreak\file{Basic.lean:719}) and ArkLib \code{7653a901}
(\file{ToCompPoly/}\allowbreak\file{Multilinear/}\allowbreak\file{Basic.lean:45}), whose own CompPoly pin \code{df591bb8} lacks it
(\cref{sec:gen-lib-comppoly-new}). Not run (no Lean in this checkout).
\fhead{Classification} Forced by upstream version skew.
\fhead{Proposed change} Before a phase imports \lean{ArkLib.}\allowbreak\lean{ToCompPoly.}\allowbreak\lean{Multilinear.}\allowbreak\lean{Basic},
elaborate a file importing it and \lean{CompPoly.Multilinear.Basic}; if it fails, file the clash
upstream (ArkLib should drop its \lean{eval_zero} once its CompPoly pin has one) and cite the
blueprint's bridge (\file{protocol-blueprint.md:246}) with that caveat.
\end{finding}

\begin{finding}{note}{f:lib-counting-bound-redundant}{The local counting bound is redundant with VCVio at the new pin}
\fhead{Evidence} \lean{SampleableType.}\allowbreak\lean{prEvent_}\allowbreak\lean{uniformSample_}\allowbreak\lean{le_div_iff}
(\file{NativeMeasure.lean:127} at VCVio \code{a4232d08}; \cref{sec:gen-l0-bounds}).
\fhead{Classification} A duplicate of upstream after the pin moved.
\fhead{Proposed change} Replace \lean{probEvent_}\allowbreak\lean{uniformSample_}\allowbreak\lean{le_of_}\allowbreak\lean{card_le} by the upstream
equivalence (plus \lean{ENNReal.coe_div}); keep \lean{…_of_subsingleton} (no upstream form) as the
one local lemma, or upstream it, per the blueprint's generic-code rule
(\file{protocol-blueprint.md:329}).
\end{finding}

\subsubsection{Negative results}\label{sec:gen-lib-negative}

Checked, and no issue found:
\begin{itemize}
\item The ArkLib definitions \lean{KnowledgeStateFunction}, \lean{rbrKnowledgeSoundnessWorstCaseWith},
  \lean{perfectCompleteness}, \lean{GuardedForm}, \lean{OutputIsPure} were read in full at
  \code{dca90385}; no way was found to satisfy \lean{rbrKnowledgeSoundnessWorstCaseWith} at error
  $0$ for a verifier that accepts a false statement, other than through the extractor
  (\cref{f:lib-existential-rbr}) or through an empty output-witness type (which makes the output
  relation empty and is visible in the statement).
\item The port \file{KnowledgeAppend.lean} was diffed line by line against \#615's file: only the
  differences listed in \cref{sec:gen-lib-ark-port}.
\item The composed error of the port is per challenge with no additive term, and the seam round is
  handled (\lean{backward_right}, \lean{extractMid_seam}); read in full, no gap found.
\item Every \texttt{\#print axioms} run reports the three standard axioms only for leanerVM's
  declarations.
\item $\K$, $\E$, \lean{y}, \lean{ofK}, \lean{g} against the specification, the Rust and the Python:
  moduli, bit order, limb order, embedding, generator, product formula (\cref{tab:gen-lib-fields};
  the probe \code{FieldFidelity}: 3 + 8 reference vectors, the defining relation, inverses, two
  mutations).
\item Irreducibility, field structure, cardinalities: proved in CompPoly without
  \lean{native_decide} (Rabin certificate checked by \lean{rfl}; standard axioms, probe
  \code{Layer0}).
\item Uniformity of both samplers; the diamond on $\K$ is definitional (\cref{sec:gen-l0-samplers}).
\item \lean{evalOracle}: query, answer, lift, the reason for the structure
  (\cref{sec:gen-l0-oracle}); \lean{card_E} (\cref{sec:gen-l0-card}); \lean{NoOracle},
  \lean{OneOracle}, \lean{noOracle_eq} (trivially correct; ArkLib's \lean{Fin 0} interface instance
  matches \lean{NoOracle} at both ArkLib pins).
\item The counting bounds: correct, tight, hypotheses load-bearing; the same statement before and
  after the probability-API port (\cref{sec:gen-l0-bounds}).
\item Axiom enforcement: lexical and transitive, with a negative control
  (\cref{sec:gen-lib-lean-validation}).
\item Clean's vacuity over $\K$ (\cref{sec:gen-lib-clean-vacuous}), leanISA's replacement
  (\cref{sec:gen-lib-clean-workaround}), and its unchanged state at Clean \code{42fe4b26}
  (\cref{sec:gen-lib-clean-new}).
\end{itemize}
